name: finora-ai
description: Finora AI — Your Money. Your Goals. One AI.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @finora/api" "npm run dev -w @finora/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @finora/shared && npm run build -w @finora/ai && npm run build -w @finora/api && npm run build -w @finora/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @finora/shared && npm run build -w @finora/ai && npm run build -w @finora/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @finora/api -- --runInBand && npm run test -w @finora/web -- --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @finora/api && npm run lint -w @finora/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @finora/shared && npm run typecheck -w @finora/ai && npm run typecheck -w @finora/api
